name: yue-apps-h5
description: 奇德芬芳 两端 uni-app 的 H5 本地构建外壳（用 UNI_INPUT_DIR 切 staff/mom；产康已并入员工端 staff，美容 beauty 移出为独立项目不参与构建，代码留 apps/beauty）

scripts.build:all: npm run build:staff && npm run build:mom
scripts.build:staff: cross-env UNI_INPUT_DIR=staff uni build -p h5 --outDir h5dist/staff --base ./
scripts.build:mom: cross-env UNI_INPUT_DIR=mom uni build -p h5 --outDir h5dist/mom --base ./
scripts.build:mp:all: npm run build:mp:staff && npm run build:mp:mom
scripts.build:mp:staff: cross-env UNI_INPUT_DIR=staff uni build -p mp-weixin --outDir mpdist/staff
scripts.build:mp:mom: cross-env UNI_INPUT_DIR=mom uni build -p mp-weixin --outDir mpdist/mom && node scripts/copy-mom-room-assets.mjs
scripts.build:demo: cross-env UNI_INPUT_DIR=demo uni build -p h5 --outDir h5dist/demo --base ./
scripts.build:mp:demo: cross-env UNI_INPUT_DIR=demo uni build -p mp-weixin --outDir mpdist/demo
